row.title: Intent Yield is a core feature, not a seed
row.body: Owner (2026-11-22): merge it completely and do not count it as a separate app or tenant. The seed manifest, lifecycle file, progress row and Q-SEED item are removed; the yield engine, /yield page and daily loop run under the core's own checks, design in docs/intent-yield-design.md.
